provenance: Golden vectors pinning the openQA HMAC-SHA1 signing wire format, derived from openQA 5c04ab0 (server side hashes the query as re-serialized by Mojo::Parameters::to_string, since the REST plugin's before_dispatch hook (OpenQA::WebAPI::Plugin::REST) parses req->url->query before OpenQA::Shared::Controller::Auth::_valid_hmac hashes req->url->to_string; the path itself is never re-serialized), computed at a fixed timestamp per vector with an independent HMAC-SHA1 implementation (Python hmac/hashlib), not ruoqa. Case 1 is a known-value HMAC used as a control. Case 2 pins the query re-serialization: %20->+ and a literal ~ -> %7E. Case 3 pins that the query re-serialization does not apply to the path. Case 4 pins a `:` -> %3A rewrite in the query.
